visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with pigtails, wearing a dark blue t-shirt and camouflage shorts, sits on a light wood-textured floor. An adult's hand enters the frame, guiding her. The background is a plain white wall in a bright indoor setting. (2) The adult holds a smartphone in one hand and a yellow snack package in the other, positioning them in front of the toddler to capture her attention. The toddler looks at the camera with a curious expression. (3) The scene shifts to close-ups of the toddler against the white wall. An adult's hands reach in to adjust her posture and straighten her hair. The child makes various facial expressions, including a serious look and then a playful one. (4) The toddler interacts with the camera, touching her forehead and pointing while smiling. The adult continues to film, capturing the child's reactions and the photos on the phone screen. (5) The toddler stands up and approaches the adult to look at the captured images on the smartphone screen. She points at the screen while the adult holds the phone. (6) The toddler walks away down a long, bright hallway towards large glass doors. The video concludes with a pink screen featuring a cartoon illustration of a girl and text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright, energetic female voice instructs a toddler, set against a quiet indoor room tone. The toddler makes small chewing sounds and soft murmurs. (2) A mechanical 'click' sound effect of a camera shutter triggers multiple times as the adult tries to take photos. The rustling of a plastic snack bag is clearly audible. (3) Laughter from the female adult breaks out as the child makes a funny noise. A playful, upbeat acoustic guitar melody fades in, accompanying the conversational tone. (4) More shutter 'clicks' occur in rapid succession. The adult's voice rises in pitch and excitement while responding to the child's poses. (5) The sound of bare feet pattering on a wooden floor is heard as the child walks away. A short, melodic electronic jingle plays at the very end as the visuals transition to the brand logo.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Task Implementation -> Humorous Complication -> Successful Outcome
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a humorous and heartwarming daily life moment of a parent attempting to take a passport photo of their toddler at home using snacks as a distraction.
